villagerbargains.config.title: Villager Bargains
villagerbargains.config.note: Applies to trades a villager unlocks from now on. Trades it already offers keep their price.
villagerbargains.pricing.minimum.descrip: Every random price lands on the cheapest value vanilla can roll.
villagerbargains.pricing.normal.descript: Vanilla behaviour: prices are rolled randomly.
villagerbargains.pricing.maximum.descrip: Every random price lands on the most expensive value vanilla can roll.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.villagerb: Pins the random part of villager trade prices to the cheapest (or most expensive) value vanilla can roll. Nothing else about trading changes.
